title: AERON_flight_model_cooked texture extension
description: The atlas page that a texture uses, written by aeron_gltf_cook. Only cooked files contain it. A cooked texture has no source of its own. KHR_texture_transform on the material's texture info places the texture within its page. Unknown fields are ignored.

source.title: Image
source.description: The image index. The image is a KTX2 array of atlas pages stored in a buffer view. Its channel is set by the material slots that reference it.

layer.title: Page
layer.description: The page of the image that the texture uses.

maxLod.title: Mip limit
maxLod.description: The deepest mip level that the texture may sample. A texture packed on a shared page stops at this level, so its neighbours do not bleed into it. Without it, there is no limit.
